text:
Raj Patel: Hey team — opened a PR to attach the new GPU pool to the us-west VPC subnets. Need a couple of approvals before the maintenance window on Thursday. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/342

Emily Zhao: taking a look now. any SG or routing changes I should watch for? :eyes:

Raj Patel: only a small SG egress for NFS plus a route table entry for the gpu-pool subnet. snippet: ```resource "aws_security_group_rule" "allow_nfs" {
  type = "egress"
  from_port = 2049
  to_port = 2049
  protocol = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = [var.nfs_cidr]
}```

Samir Khan: @Emily I can run TF fmt and check the state migration notes later today. won't be long.

infra-bot: deploy window scheduled: 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC — manual approval required.

Ben Ortiz: I can review this afternoon. quick ask: can we lock var.nfs_cidr to the on-prem prefix instead of a broad range? want to avoid accidental exposure.

Emily Zhao: agree with Ben — please reference module.onprem.cidr_block and add a short canary/rollout plan for nodes.

Raj Patel: will push a change with the cidr reference and add canary notes. ping here when you finish review — target is to merge before the deploy window. :pray:

Samir Khan: reviewing now, will post comments on the PR for any TF state concerns.

Ben Ortiz: approved the SG change, left one minor nit on resource naming. :thumbsup:

Emily Zhao: LGTM after the cidr fix is pushed.

Raj Patel: pushed the fix, squashed commits, and updated the PR description with the rollout steps. CI running — will merge once green. thanks!
